about_the_game:
AstroLite is a Survivors-like Twin-Stick Roguelite set in space. Inspired by Atari Asteroid and developed with modern gameplay features.

Key Features:

  • Skill Tree with Multiple Tiers of Progression!

  • Five Unlockable Elements to Empower your Runs!

  • Six Unique Abilities to keep you on Top!

  • Perk Points that Enable you to Scale how Upgrades Work In-Game!

  • Over 60 Diverse Achievements- Tailored for Completionists.

  • Mouse, WASD, and Full Controller Support!

Each Galactica Level provides you with a unique challenge, mixing and matching different special enemies with unique bosses to create extremely challenging situations for unprepared players. Levels can last indefinitely, but contain a soft enrage timer that ensures players without the best of the best upgrades will slowly trail off towards their demise. Completing five Galactica Levels will upgrade the Galaxy you play in, and reward you with a Perk Point that can be used to permanently increase the effect of a specific upgrade type in game.

Earn Luna Coins for every minute you survive in the galaxy. Luna Coins are directly spent on the skill tree, unlocking progressively stronger and stronger skills, elements, and unique passives that allow you to survive the progressively more challenging galaxies ahead. Skills include a Sentry helper, which shoots alongside you independently of where you aim. Unique passives like Corrupt Upgrades that manipulate in-game upgrades to give massively empowered bonuses and the cost of a negative effect. Unique Luna Enemies can be unlocked, which when defeated award the player with enormous Luna Coin loot piles or Legendary upgrades depending on their type.

Gameplay too simple? Matches take too long? Hate thinking for yourself when it comes to upgrades? Start using challenges! Over 20 unique and stackable challenges exist within Astrolite to both mix up how gameplay feels, and improve your Luna Coin and Score rewards! Slip-Space Mode speeds up gameplay by 75% at the cost of Luna Coin rewards. Blind-Pick Mode removes the ability to choose your level up rewards, and instead automates them. Want there to be FOUR bosses spawning each time instead of one? There's a challenge for that. Want the game to be incredibly difficult, and lose at the FIRST instance of damage? There's a challenge for that too.

short_description: Obliterate asteroids in a race against time in this Twin-Stick Roguelite. Level up to stay on top of the looming threat. Spend Luna Coins on permanent Skill Tree unlocks. Each mission has unique enemies, challenging bosses, and unpredictable twists.
